snippet.title: Farm Ricochet POWER UP GUIDE: every way to get stronger (heroes, items, chests, Wishing Well) 📈💪🏻
snippet.description:
New to the farm and your team keeps losing? Personal trainer Loot Goblin opens the Farm Gym and walks you through every way to get stronger: read your Power, level up by playing, collect your loot, Talents, free chests, Ascension, Legacy, Transmutation, gear and the Forge, recycling, the Mythic Wishing Well and, as an optional shortcut, the Market (gems or USDC). 💪

Almost everything is free: play, collect and invest wisely!

Play free in your browser: https://farmricochet.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/4xzvpvZmDn
X: https://x.com/farmricochet (@farmricochet)
